entries.title: OB3M9
entries.creator: Giuseppe Zemba
entries.use: All three enemy types use this robot model. The original GLB is distributed as a provenance reference; the simplified GLB is loaded in the game.
entries.changes: Simplified from 18,756 to 8,036 triangles; reoriented, reposed and given original rigid-joint walking animation. Silver/ivory armor, shared PBR wear, status lights, wider role-specific proportions and larger elites are game modifications. No creator endorsement is implied.

entries.title: Concrete Floor Worn 02
entries.creator: Dimitrios Savva
entries.use: Poly Haven diffuse, normal and packed surface maps for the concrete yard.
entries.changes: Source images unchanged; tiled with adjusted tint and normal strength.

entries.title: Rusty Metal 02
entries.creator: Rob Tuytel
entries.use: Poly Haven diffuse, normal and packed surface maps for perimeter steel; shared wear on survivor armor and robot hulls.
entries.changes: Source images unchanged; material color, roughness and normal strength adjusted in the game.

entries.title: Factory Yard
entries.creator: Sergej Majboroda
entries.use: Poly Haven HDR environment for reflections and indirect lighting.
entries.changes: Unmodified HDR file; lighting intensity adjusted. Not used as a background image.

entries.title: Barrel 03
entries.creator: Serhii Khromov
entries.use: Poly Haven glTF model, geometry buffer and diffuse/normal/packed surface maps at the yard edges.
entries.changes: Source files unchanged; centered, reoriented from Y-up to Z-up and scaled to 1.8 world units high.

entries.title: Metal Plate
entries.creator: Rob Tuytel
entries.use: Poly Haven diffuse photograph on the HUD and reward panels.
entries.changes: Source image unchanged; darkened and tiled through CSS.

entries.title: Particle Pack 1.1
entries.creator: Kenney Vleugels / Kenney
entries.use: circle_05, flare_01 and smoke_01 provide sparks, flashes, explosion smoke and yard dust.
entries.changes: Unmodified PNGs; tinted, scaled and faded in the game. Pack filter-template credits: Indigo Ray, Craig Nisbet, Zoltan Erdokovy, Heliagon, ThreeDee, Killst4r and Tim2501.

entries.title: Animated Mech Pack — Stan, Mike, George
entries.creator: Quaternius
entries.use: Industrial walkers for Foundry Walker, Rampage Chassis and Ember Furnace. No dinosaurs.
entries.changes: Official OGA zip FBX (Stan, Mike, George) plus pack textures converted in Blender 5.2 to GLB with clips, then Draco/WebP optimized. Skinned bind poses were not baked; runtime reorients Y-up to Z-up, samples the posed AABB after the walk clip, and grounds on Z=0. Inner files: FBX/Stan.fbx, FBX/Mike.fbx, FBX/George.fbx.

entries.title: Toon Shooter Game Kit — Tank
entries.creator: Quaternius
entries.changes: Delivered Poly Pizza Tank GLB reoriented to Z-up, grounded, and scaled so length ≈ 11 world units. Draco-optimized. Inner mesh: Tank.

entries.title: Ultimate Spaceships Pack — Insurgent, Omen, Executioner
entries.creator: Quaternius
entries.use: Insurgent hull for Open-Field Raider, Omen stealth craft for Lock Drone, Executioner airframe for Sky Leviathan.
entries.changes: Official OpenGameArt zip (Quaternius upload). Insurgent remains the baked Open-Field Raider hull. Omen.fbx + Omen_Orange.png and Executioner.fbx + Executioner_Blue.png were converted in Blender 5.2 to GLB and Draco/WebP optimized; runtime reorients and grounds them. Inner files: Insurgent/FBX/Insurgent.fbx, Omen/FBX/Omen.fbx, Executioner/FBX/Executioner.fbx.

entries.title: Steampunk Turret Pack — Laser Quad
entries.creator: Quaternius
entries.use: Multi-barrel industrial turret for Phase Crawler.
entries.changes: Official OGA zip Laser_Quad.fbx converted in Blender 5.2 to GLB, Draco-optimized. Runtime reorients Y-up to Z-up and grounds the posed AABB on Z=0. Inner file: FBX/Laser_Quad.fbx.

entries.title: Ultimate Space Kit — Round Rover
entries.creator: Quaternius
entries.use: Wide wheeled rover for Plate Hauler. Replaces the earlier planet-as-boss fallback.
entries.changes: Official-kit GLB zip Round Rover.glb, Draco-optimized. Runtime reorients and grounds on Z=0. Inner file: Round Rover.glb.

entries.title: Cute Animated Monsters — Mushroom
entries.creator: Quaternius
entries.use: Round candy mushroom for Jelly Prince. Pack page confirmed CC0 at intake.
entries.changes: Official OGA zip (Quaternius upload) Mushroom.fbx plus Mushroom_Texture.png converted in Blender 5.2 to GLB with the Idle clip, then Draco/WebP optimized. Skinned; runtime reorients and normalizes height to 10.175 wu. Inner files: FBX/Mushroom.fbx, Textures/Mushroom_Texture.png.

entries.title: Survival Kit — Chest
entries.creator: Kenney Vleugels / Kenney
entries.use: Closed chest drop plus optional open box swap after Jelly Prince dies.
entries.changes: Official Kenney 2.0 GLBs (Models/GLB format/chest.glb and box-open.glb) reoriented to Z-up, grounded, scaled to pickup height ≈ 1.4 wu, Draco/WebP optimized. Closed chest keeps open/close clips.

scope: Creative Commons and QAL artwork used in Man vs. Clankers, including boss and chest intake from 2026-09-07.
